# Wi-Fi qualification matrix

<!-- Generated by tools/qualification/qualify.py --product wifi matrix --write from docs/qualification/wifi-matrix.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

What each state means and what evidence it needs is in [README.md](README.md). A state other than Unqualified is accepted only when cited evidence under `tests/fixtures/wifi/qualification/` shows it; `qualify.py --product wifi matrix --check` enforces that in CI. No row says PASS: a state names the evidence behind it.

## Evidence

- `lab-aruba-instant-member` (synthetic): Synthetic Aruba Instant member AP (virtual-controller address 0.0.0.0): the cluster tables are absent, so every cluster dataset is unsupported. Classification: Controller absent, AP inventory unsupported, AP state unsupported, Radio inventory unsupported, Radio state unsupported.
- `lab-aruba-instant-vc` (synthetic): Synthetic Aruba Instant virtual controller listing six APs: one down, one with a radio down, one radio at 82% utilisation, a tri-radio AP with a 6 GHz radio and overlapping channel numbers, and an AP with no radios. Classification: Controller ok, AP inventory ok, AP state ok, Radio inventory ok, Radio state ok.
